Generated Narrative: ValueSet ahip-relationship-status

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-MaritalStatus version 📍5.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    MMarriedA current marriage contract is active
    DDivorcedMarriage contract has been declared dissolved and inactive
    LSeparated
    WWidowedThe spouse has died
    TIn a registered domestic partnershipPerson declares that a domestic partner relationship exists.
    USingleCurrently not in a marriage contract.
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-temporary-codes version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplay
    DATIDating (Non-committed relationship)
    MONRMonogamous relationship (Committed relationship with one person)
    POLYPolyamorous relationship (Committed relationship with more than one person)
  • Include these codes as defined in http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/v3-NullFlavor version 📍4.0.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    ASKUI don't knowInformation was sought but not found (e.g., patient was asked but didn't know)
  • Include these codes as defined in http://ahip.org/demographics/CodeSystem/ahip-demo-additional-nullFlavor version 📦0.1.0
    CodeDisplayDefinition
    CNTRI choose not to respond at this timeThis code is to represent explicitly that the patient has chosen not to respond to this question at this time.
